records.question: John puts $25 in his piggy bank every month for 2 years to save up for a vacation. He had to spend $400 from his piggy bank savings last week to repair his car. How many dollars are left in his piggy bank?
records.response:
John saves 25*12 = 300 dollars every year.
So, after 2 years, he saves 300*2 = 600 dollars.
After spending 400 dollars on car repairs, he has 600 - 400 = 200 dollars left in his piggy bank.
#### 200

records.question: Porter earns $8 per day and works 5 times a week. His manager is asking him to work an extra day that promises him an extra fifty percent on top of his daily rate. How much money will he earn after a month if he renders overtime every week?
records.response:
Porter earns $8 per day and works 5 times a week, so he earns 8 * 5 = $40 per week.
His overtime rate is 50% more than his regular rate, so he earns 8 * 1.5 = $12 per overtime day.
He works an extra day of overtime every week, so he earns 12 per overtime day.
He works 5 regular days and 1 overtime day per week, so he earns 40 + 12 = $52 per week.
There are 4 weeks in a month, so he earns 52 * 4 = $208 per month.
#### 208
